result:
The test suite compiles successfully. I created `tests/org/apache/commons/lang3/StringUtilsAgentTest.java`, a self-contained JUnit 5 test class covering `StringUtils` broadly:

- Null/blank/empty predicates (`isEmpty`, `isBlank`, `isAny*`, `isAll*`, `isNone*`)
- Trimming/stripping (`trim`, `strip`, `stripToEmpty/Null`, `stripStart/End/All/Accents`)
- Equality/comparison (`equals*`, `compare*`, `startsWith*`, `endsWith*`)
- Index/search methods (`indexOf*`, `lastIndexOf*`, `ordinalIndexOf`, `contains*`, `countMatches`)
- Defaults and distance metrics (`defaultIfBlank/Empty`, `getIfBlank/Empty`, Levenshtein/Jaro-Winkler/fuzzy distances, including documented `IllegalArgumentException` cases)
- Character-class checks (`isAlpha*`, `isNumeric*`, `isAsciiPrintable`, `isMixedCase`, case checks)
- `join`/`joinWith` across array, `Iterable`, `Iterator`, `List`, and varargs overloads
- `left`/`right`/`mid`, padding, `center`, `length`, case conversion, `normalizeSpace`, `overlay`
- `appendIfMissing`/`prependIfMissing`, the large `remove*`/`replace*` family (including regex variants and `IllegalArgumentException`/`IllegalStateException` cases for `replaceEach(Repeatedly)`)
- `reverse`, `rotate`, the full `split*` family, `substring*` family, `abbreviate*`, `chomp`/`chop`, `truncate` (with boundary exceptions), `wrap`/`unwrap`/`wrapIfMissing`, and byte/char conversions (`toCodePoints`, `valueOf`, `getBytes`, `toEncodedString`)

Every expectation was cross-checked against the exact examples/contracts in `api/org/apache/commons/lang3/StringUtils.html` (I found and discarded one javadoc copy-paste inconsistency around a `char`-delimiter `join` overload rather than relying on it). No files other than this test class were modified, and `./compile.sh` reports `compiled OK`.
